correctness.rationale: After the a-th zero, enumerate q>=b ones, and let t_i be preceding-zero totals. Classifying an occurrence by its first chosen 1 gives the exact weighted identity k=sum_{i=1}^{q-b+1} binom(q-i,b-1)binom(t_i,a). The first r=q-b+1 monotone t_i determine all contributing terms; binom(q,b)<=k and binom(t_r,a)<=k ensure a finite profile set, including b=1 boundary. The first a zeros and remaining b-1 unconstrained ones delimit a+b free slots, giving unique length decomposition q+t_r+sum free nonnegative gaps, hence generating function numerator over (1-z)^(a+b). Positive numerator at z=1 proves exact eventual degree if attainable. The example a=b=2,k=5 has unique (q=3;t=2,3) giving z^6/(1-z)^4. Independently enumerated all short binary words with DP occurrence counting and confirmed profile results; this does not prove unbounded parameters.
